bio:
John Grub (c.1765 - after 1826), Forks Twp farmer who inherited jointly with Frederick (1800 deed).

FamilySearch gives John two wives, Anna Margaretha Schuch (1769-1809) and Sally Ripple, with children from 1790. It has him in the 1800 census as John Grub and in 1810 as John Croop, and attaches the will of his brother-in-law Gottlieb Hipp (Will Book 6 pp.18-19), which presumably names him ([R4-S1]). A Schuch wife is a link back to the Ulmet Schuch family of the Dolls.
